metadata.description: Film Plan — a film is a thing that happens over time, and a document cannot show you that. Plan it as a page you can talk to.

plugins.name: film-plan
plugins.description: Plan a film as a page instead of a document. Builds a scene-by-scene storyboard with drawn frames, narration and timing, and attaches a chat rail that edits the plan by talking to it — every change validated, committed and undoable.
